_comment: Email triage label set. Copy to agent/local/config/triage-labels.json. Read by lib/triage-labels.cjs and every triage path (local-triage, jev-email-triage, triage-decide, p1-sender). `labels` is the full ordered list (the order prompts show it in) and must keep "spam", which maps to Gmail's Spam folder; `descriptions` are the one-line glosses the classifier sees; `vendor_examples` names platforms you use, for the spam-vs-vendor line. Labels are lowercase Gmail label names.

descriptions.work: mail about your job or your own projects

vendor_examples: a ticketing site, a forum, a cloud host, etc.
